name: Florida

response.rule_text: No set time limit; only a reasonable time to retrieve and redact is permitted (Tribune Co. v. Cannella; automatic 24/48-hour delays impermissible).

fees.labor_rule: 'Search or exploration' and employee-time fees may not be charged, but a special service charge is allowed for extensive clerical or IT resources, Fla. Stat. § 119.07(4)(d).
fees.copy_rule: Actual cost of duplication; if no fee prescribed by law, not more than $0.15 per one-sided copy up to 14x8.5 in and $0.05 extra per two-sided copy, § 119.07(4)(a).

residency.rule_text: Anyone; the citizenship requirement was removed in 1975.

appeal.body: Voluntary Attorney General mediation (Fla. Stat. 16.60), then mandamus in circuit court
appeal.rule_text: No administrative appeal; enforcement by civil suit (ch. 119), with optional voluntary mediation through the Attorney General's office, Fla. Stat. § 16.60. No statutory limit on suit; general 4-year statute applies.

notes: Governor/Cabinet covered when sitting as board prescribed by Legislature; Legislature covered unless it provides contrary legislative rule. Silence-is-denial, universities and school districts not extracted. Fee waiver not found.
